page_title: HEI 1-3 WOL | Heidenheim v Wolfsburg 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
90+2' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) has tested the patience of referee Benjamin Brand and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' The substitution is prepared. Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andreas Skov Olsen.
89' Paul Simonis has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) replacing Kilian Fischer.
87' 1 - 3 Goal! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Diant Ramaj into right side of the goal.
87' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is going to take the penalty!
85' Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a penalty to Wolfsburg! Let's see who's going to take it.
84' Heidenheim enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
81' The game is interrupted. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
80' The attendance for today's match is 13000.
78' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Tim Siersleben will be replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
76' Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
75' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Arijon Ibrahimovic can be given a rest.
71' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) replaces Budu Zivzivadze.
70' The game is interrupted now, Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

66' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Maximilian Arnold and scores magnificently from close range into the right side of the goal. 1:2.
64' Substitution. Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dzenan Pejcinovic walks off.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
62' Frank Schmidt is forced to make a change. Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is unable to continue due to injury, Luca Kerber comes on.
61' Substitution. Jonas Fohrenbach is replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
61' Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diant Ramaj intercepts the ball.
58' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
57' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
56' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:4.
52' Wolfsburg fail to score from a corner as Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
51' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Diant Ramaj was alert and made a comfortable save.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benjamin Brand had an easy-decision to make.
41' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
40' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
38' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Diant Ramaj easily deals with the threat.
37' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
36' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
34' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
34' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) crosses the ball into the box from a free kick, but Kamil Grabara reads it well and gathers the ball. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
34' Benjamin Brand interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Heidenheim are awarded a free kick.
32' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

29' 1 - 1 Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) takes the free kick from a promising position. He has already proven that he can handle such situations and once again, he sends the ball towards the top right corner, bouncing in off the post.
28' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Benjamin Brand no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Heidenheim.
27' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:5. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.

20' 0 - 1 Patrick Wimmer slides a pass towards Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top left corner. The score is now 0:1.
19' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
17' The foul by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) was seen by Benjamin Brand who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
16' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
15' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.

12' Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) gets in a header from the resulting free kick. It lacks accuracy, however, to bother the keeper and the ball goes a few metres over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

10' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
7' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for an infringement.
5' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
4' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.
3' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand will referee today's match.
